post.description:
``event: start | token | done | error`` over ``text/event-stream``.

equals the gross premium (else a warning, as before).

The registered / in-progress antecedentes (Bases Técnicas) of one account.

``schema`` is the resolved per-ramo LINE definition (or ``None`` when the
account has no line yet — the CTA is then disabled with a reason).
``payload`` is the staged (review) or human-validated (registered) sectioned
data. ``required_fields`` is the line's mandatory checklist and
``missing_required`` the subset still empty; ``complete`` is True when nothing
mandatory is missing — the frontend gates the Descargar Bases Técnicas button
on it and ``GET /pdf`` returns 409 when it is False.

AntecedentesRegisterRequest.title: AntecedentesRegisterRequest
AntecedentesRegisterRequest.description: The human-completed payload to validate and register.

ArchiveResponse.title: ArchiveResponse
ArchiveResponse.description:
The generated ZIP is a ``document(entity_type=account_group,
category=archive_pack)`` row — the key lives only there (rule 8).

AssetClientSummary.title: AssetClientSummary
AssetClientSummary.description: Enough of the owning client to render a row without a second request.

AssetCreate.title: AssetCreate
AssetCreate.description:
Create an asset under one of the broker's clients.

``client_id`` is optional in the body only because the nested route
``POST /clients/{client_id}/assets`` supplies it from the path. On the flat
``POST /assets`` route it is required.

AssetListItem.title: AssetListItem
AssetListItem.description: One row of the assets list.

AssetRead.title: AssetRead
AssetRead.description: Full asset detail: the promoted columns plus the JSON tail.

AssetSummary.title: AssetSummary
AssetSummary.description: Aggregate counters for the assets list view.

AssetUpdate.title: AssetUpdate
AssetUpdate.description: Patch an asset. Every field optional; ``client_id`` is not re-assignable.

AssignableRole.title: AssignableRole
AssignableRole.description: A role the current actor is allowed to grant — powers the invite form.

BrokerProposalCreate.title: BrokerProposalCreate
BrokerProposalCreate.description: Mint a propuesta from a comparison and its chosen winning offer.

CaseActivateStage.title: CaseActivateStage
CaseActivateStage.description:
``POST /case-files/{id}/activate-stage`` — re-enter a SKIPPED stage
(only while the folder has no policy).

CaseClientAttach.title: CaseClientAttach
CaseClientAttach.description:
``POST /case-files/{id}/clients`` — add a RUT to the account.

422 ``client_not_in_group`` when the client's group differs from the
folder's; the contratante (``case_file.client_id``) cannot be removed.

CaseDocumentRead.title: CaseDocumentRead
CaseDocumentRead.description: One filed document, with its Spanish label and a download URL.

CaseEntryOrigin.title: CaseEntryOrigin
CaseEntryOrigin.description:
Where an account folder was BORN in the partial journey (team ``origen``).

Deliberately NOT ``CaseOrigin``: that enum is the v3 ORIGIN AXIS
(new / renewal / period_change — siblings in time) and is already the
NOT NULL ``case_file.origin`` column. This is an orthogonal fact — which
door the work came through — so it lives in ``case_file.entry_origin``.

CaseFileCreate.title: CaseFileCreate
CaseFileCreate.description:
Open an expediente.

The server assigns ``reference``, ``sequence_no`` and ``version``; a client
may not spoof any of the three.

CaseFileDetail.title: CaseFileDetail
CaseFileDetail.description: The expediente page payload: case + refs + counts + children + timeline tip.

CaseFileKind.title: CaseFileKind
CaseFileKind.description: What the expediente is about. ``account`` wraps a placement 1:1.

CaseFileListItem.title: CaseFileListItem
CaseFileListItem.description:
A row of ``GET /case-files``.

Carries the offer facts the Portafolio's Cotizaciones tab needs: how many
cotizaciones (an insurer's INBOUND offer = a ``proposal`` row) landed on the
folder, and which companies sent them. Both are filled by the list router in
ONE grouped aggregate over the page, and both default to empty, so a folder
with no offers is ``0`` / ``[]`` and never null. Deliberately NOT on
``CaseFileRead``: ``CaseFileDetail`` already carries its own
``proposals_count`` and the single-case payloads must not change shape.

grouped.description: Buckets listos para el gráfico cuando se pide ?group_by=.

CaseFileSummary.title: CaseFileSummary
CaseFileSummary.description: The pipeline board: counts by kind and by stage.

CaseFileUpdate.title: CaseFileUpdate
CaseFileUpdate.description: Patch the human-editable fields. ``stage`` moves only via /transition.

CaseFileVersionCreate.title: CaseFileVersionCreate
CaseFileVersionCreate.description: Clone the case at ``version + 1``, superseding the current row.

CaseHistoryResponse.title: CaseHistoryResponse
CaseHistoryResponse.description:
``GET /case-files/{id}/history`` — the origin chain plus the immediate
prior folder's records, policies and claims. ``prior`` is ``null`` for a
folder with ``origin=new`` ("Sin vigencia anterior").

CaseOrigin.title: CaseOrigin
CaseOrigin.description:
How an account folder came to exist — the ORIGIN axis of ``case_file``.

Three axes never mix (docs/v3-groups-accounts-spec.md §1): origin
(``origin`` + ``origin_case_file_id``: siblings in time), version
(``supersedes_case_file_id``: rework) and post-sale (``parent_case_file_id``
+ ``policy_id``: children of a policy). A renewal folder is a SIBLING of the
prior vigencia, never its child.

CasePriorContext.title: CasePriorContext
CasePriorContext.description:
Read-only context from the folder this one was renewed / re-perioded
from. ``records`` is keyed by the navigator's ``RecordFolder.key``
(``amounts``, ``loss_history``, ``report``, ``questionnaire``, ``slip``).

CaseRenewBody.title: CaseRenewBody
CaseRenewBody.description:
``POST /case-files/{id}/renew`` — invoked on the ACCOUNT folder, never
on a policy (rule 4). Opens a ``kind=renewal, origin=renewal`` sibling in
the next vigencia under the same group with cloned placements.

``copy_sections`` lists the sub-expediente sections whose documents are
copied into the new folder as NEW ``document`` rows on NEW storage keys
(never two rows on one key). Defaults to the root (00A antecedentes).

CaseReperiodBody.title: CaseReperiodBody
CaseReperiodBody.description:
``POST /case-files/{id}/reperiod`` — the ONLY door for a vigencia date
change once the folder is ``period_locked`` (rule 1). Opens a sibling
``kind=account, origin=period_change`` folder and closes the source with
``meta.closed_reason="period_change"``.

CaseSection.title: CaseSection
CaseSection.description:
Sub-expediente vocabulary, derived 1:1 from the demo corpus folder tree.

Used by ``document.section``, ``case_pack.section`` and the extraction
category registry. The Spanish folder names live in i18n, never here.

CaseSkipTo.title: CaseSkipTo
CaseSkipTo.description:
``POST /case-files/{id}/skip-to`` — jump forward, marking the stages in
between as *omitida* (accounts: quotes_received, insured_decision,
policy_issued, active).

CaseStage.title: CaseStage
CaseStage.description:
The journey machine (docs/v2-case-files-spec.md §5).

The account/renewal chain encodes hitos c1-c7 of the corredor lane; the
post-sale kinds have their own short chains. ``closed`` is terminal and
reachable from anywhere.

CatalogLineRead.title: CatalogLineRead
CatalogLineRead.description: One global ramo with its active subtipos, in catalogue order.

CategoryFieldRead.title: CategoryFieldRead
CategoryFieldRead.description: One top-level field of a category schema, for the generic review form.

CategorySpecRead.title: CategorySpecRead
CategorySpecRead.description: One registry row as JSON — everything the UI needs to render it.

ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest
ChangePasswordRequest.description: Self-service password change for the authenticated user.

ClaimClose.title: ClaimClose
ClaimClose.description: The adjuster's final ruling — the only way a claim reaches ``closed``.

ClaimItemKind.title: ClaimItemKind
ClaimItemKind.description: Per-partida damage families the adjuster's tables are grouped by.

ClaimItemsReplace.title: ClaimItemsReplace
ClaimItemsReplace.description: Full replace of the adjuster's table — the shape the reports arrive in.

ClaimSummary.title: ClaimSummary
ClaimSummary.description:
The prior vigencia's claims, as the renewal screen needs them —
a projection of ``ClaimRead`` without the item tables.

rut.title: Rut
rut.description: Chilean RUT; mod-11 validated, stored BODY-DV

ClientCreate.title: ClientCreate
ClientCreate.description:
Create a client from a RUT.

``legal_name`` is required only when the RUT is unknown to the platform
(i.e. the canonical insured has to be created). When the insured already
exists, any ``insured_*`` field that is currently empty on the canonical row
is filled in from this payload; existing values are never overwritten,
because that row is shared with other brokers.

ClientListItem.title: ClientListItem
ClientListItem.description: One row of the clients list. Excludes ``internal_notes`` (detail only).

ClientPage.title: ClientPage
ClientPage.description: A page of clients plus the counters the list header shows.

ClientRead.title: ClientRead
ClientRead.description: Full client detail, including the broker-private notes.

grouped.description: Buckets listos para el gráfico cuando se pide ?group_by=.

ClientSummary.title: ClientSummary
ClientSummary.description: Aggregate counters for the clients list view.

ClientUpdate.title: ClientUpdate
ClientUpdate.description:
Patch the broker-private side of a client.

The canonical insured is deliberately NOT patchable here: it is shared
across brokers, so editing it is a separate, explicit operation.

CollectionLevelPreference.title: CollectionLevelPreference
CollectionLevelPreference.description: The broker's choice per plan; ``auto`` lets the resolver pick native.

CollectionStatusRead.title: CollectionStatusRead
CollectionStatusRead.description: The derived dashboard: outstanding, overdue, compliance %, alerts.

CollectionSummaryRead.title: CollectionSummaryRead
CollectionSummaryRead.description: The cobranza line of a policy row: next cuota, arrears and level.

CollectionsSummary.title: CollectionsSummary
CollectionsSummary.description: The legacy generic summary (status split, scope, group_by) + the v12 cards.

ComparisonAlignmentResult.title: ComparisonAlignmentResult
ComparisonAlignmentResult.description:
The response to POST /comparisons/{id}/align — the standardized table.

``used_ai`` is always True now (the holistic comparison is AI-only; when the
provider is down the endpoint returns a clean provider error instead of this).
``batched`` flags that the readings exceeded the input threshold and were run
in batches then merged. ``recommendation`` is the AI's recommended offer.

ComparisonColumn.title: ComparisonColumn
ComparisonColumn.description: One proposal as a column of the comparison grid.

ComparisonCreate.title: ComparisonCreate
ComparisonCreate.description: Open (or fetch) the comparison for an account's COMPARISON stage.

ComparisonEntryCreate.title: ComparisonEntryCreate
ComparisonEntryCreate.description:
Add one uploaded cotización to the grid.

The document is created through the normal documents flow first; here we only
receive its id and read it dynamically.

ComparisonEntryRead.title: ComparisonEntryRead
ComparisonEntryRead.description: One column of a comparison, with its cached source verdict.

ComparisonEntryResult.title: ComparisonEntryResult
ComparisonEntryResult.description:
The response to adding a column: the entry plus the read verdict.

A ``not_a_proposal`` upload is a visible rejection here (``is_wrong_file`` +
``rejection_reason``), never a 422 — the broker keeps a rejected column in
the grid and can delete it.

ComparisonEntryUpdate.title: ComparisonEntryUpdate
ComparisonEntryUpdate.description: Human curation of one column: recommend, reorder, or override the facets.

ComparisonPremiumCore.title: ComparisonPremiumCore
ComparisonPremiumCore.description:
The fixed money/period core an entry extracted, surfaced PRE-promotion.

Read DIRECTLY from the column's already-persisted ``extraction.parsed``
(the ``BudgetProposalExtraction`` payload) — never re-extracted, never
re-validated (money invariants stay on promote/proposal). This lets the grid
show a premium/rate highlight row-group across columns before any column is
promoted to a real ``proposal``. Null when the column is a wrong-file or has
no parse. Values are surfaced verbatim as stored (display only), so every
leaf is lenient.

ComparisonPromote.title: ComparisonPromote
ComparisonPromote.description: Promote a column's fixed money core into a real inbound ``proposal``.

ComparisonPromoteResult.title: ComparisonPromoteResult
ComparisonPromoteResult.description:
The response to promoting a column into a real ``proposal``.

``warnings`` carries SOFT money notes (currently rate additivity) that did not
block the promote — e.g. a comprehensive "tasa media" that is not the sum of
the per-peril rates.

ComparisonQuote.title: ComparisonQuote
ComparisonQuote.description: The ask the proposals are answering.

ComparisonRead.title: ComparisonRead
ComparisonRead.description: The comparison header + columns + aligned grid + snapshotted dictionary.

ContextRef.title: ContextRef
ContextRef.description: One @-mention attached to a user message.

CoverageKind.title: CoverageKind
CoverageKind.description: A coverage line item is either something covered or something excluded.

CoverageRow.title: CoverageRow
CoverageRow.description: One aligned coverage (or exclusion) across every proposal of the quote.

CoverageSuggestion.title: CoverageSuggestion
CoverageSuggestion.description: One covered item or one exclusion, as read off the document.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: loss | insured_amount | fixed | days — what the % applies to

DeductibleEntry-Input.title: DeductibleEntry
DeductibleEntry-Input.description:
One peril's deductible.

Deliberately permissive (``extra="allow"``): perils differ per insurance
line and the basis differs per peril — fire is a % of the LOSS, earthquake a
% of the INSURED AMOUNT of the affected item, with UF minimums. Anything the
document states beyond these fields is kept verbatim rather than dropped.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: loss | insured_amount | fixed | days — what the % applies to

DeductibleEntry-Output.title: DeductibleEntry
DeductibleEntry-Output.description:
One peril's deductible.

Deliberately permissive (``extra="allow"``): perils differ per insurance
line and the basis differs per peril — fire is a % of the LOSS, earthquake a
% of the INSURED AMOUNT of the affected item, with UF minimums. Anything the
document states beyond these fields is kept verbatim rather than dropped.

DeductibleTerm.title: DeductibleTerm
DeductibleTerm.description:
One peril's deductible.

The *basis* differs per peril — fire is a percentage of the loss while
earthquake is a percentage of the insured amount of the affected item — so
the basis travels with the number. Unknown extra keys are preserved: lines
other than property carry their own vocabulary (waiting periods, per-event
caps) and this must not silently drop them.

DocumentCategory.title: DocumentCategory
DocumentCategory.description:
Every document kind the platform knows how to file and, where a schema
exists, extract.

The first block is the original v2 set (kept byte-identical). The second is
the case-file registry merged from both analyst taxonomies — one canonical
English slug per document type, deduped across the two vocabularies.

``PROPOSAL`` is KEPT AND DEPRECATED: it is what the current AI upload flow
writes for an insurer quotation, so the existing route and its tests keep
working. The registry maps it to the same spec as ``INSURER_QUOTATION``;
new code writes ``INSURER_QUOTATION``.

DocumentConfirmRequest.title: DocumentConfirmRequest
DocumentConfirmRequest.description: COMMIT the human-reviewed payload for any registry category.

DocumentDownload.title: DocumentDownload
DocumentDownload.description:
A short-lived URL for the stored bytes.

``expires_in_seconds`` is ``None`` for the local backend, whose URLs are
served statically and do not expire.

DocumentExtraction.title: DocumentExtraction
DocumentExtraction.description:
The pieces of data extracted from ONE antecedentes document (the review
UI's "Extracción" subtab renders one card per file).

``payload`` is that document's own sectioned extraction (``None`` when the
file still needs vision extraction). ``needs_vision`` flags an image/scanned
file whose text could not be read — a vision-model fallback is not yet
implemented, so the file is surfaced here rather than silently dropped.

category.title: Category
category.description: Override the document's filed category (registry slug)

DocumentExtractionRequest.title: DocumentExtractionRequest
DocumentExtractionRequest.description: Ask the model to read one uploaded document with its registry schema.

DocumentExtractionResponse.title: DocumentExtractionResponse
DocumentExtractionResponse.description: SUGGEST, generic: the audit row plus the category's own payload.

DocumentUpdate.title: DocumentUpdate
DocumentUpdate.description: Metadata-only patch. The stored bytes and their key are immutable.

EndorsementBatchCreate.title: EndorsementBatchCreate
EndorsementBatchCreate.description:
``POST /endorsements/batch`` — one prórroga over N policies.

The policies are chosen EXPLICITLY (never derived from a period, rule 3)
and must all sit under the same ``account_group_id``, else 422
``policies_span_groups``. The server mints one ``batch_key`` (uuid4) and
writes one ``Endorsement`` + one ``case_file(kind=endorsement)`` per
policy, all with ZERO premium deltas — a prórroga moves
``policy.end_date`` only, never the account folder's period.

EndorsementBatchIssue.title: EndorsementBatchIssue
EndorsementBatchIssue.description:
``POST /endorsements/batch/{batch_key}/issue`` — issues every member
through the existing single-endorsement path and applies the period
extension once per policy. The carrier usually sends ONE document for the
whole prórroga, so ``issued_document_id`` is shared by all members.

EndorsementBatchItem.title: EndorsementBatchItem
EndorsementBatchItem.description: One policy's share of a batch.

EndorsementBatchResponse.title: EndorsementBatchResponse
EndorsementBatchResponse.description:
``{batch_key, items}`` — the answer to both batch endpoints.

``GET /endorsements?batch_key=<key>`` returns the same members as an
ordinary ``EndorsementPage``.

EndorsementIssue.title: EndorsementIssue
EndorsementIssue.description: Attach the carrier's issued document and apply the deltas.

EndorsementIssueResult.title: EndorsementIssueResult
EndorsementIssueResult.description: What issuing an endorsement moved, in one payload.

EndorsementKind.title: EndorsementKind
EndorsementKind.description:
The 15 endorsement motives observed in the corpus, plus ``period_extension``.

The capitalised verb in the carrier's ``motive`` text (INCLUYE / EXCLUYE /
AUMENTA / DISMINUYE) is the signal the classifier keys on.

``PERIOD_EXTENSION`` (prórroga) is the one motive the corpus does not show:
it is created only through ``POST /endorsements/batch`` (one endorsement per
policy sharing a ``batch_key``) and moves ``policy.end_date`` only — never
the account folder's period. 16 chars < ``aggregate_reinstatement`` (23),
so the VARCHAR length is unchanged.

EntitySummary.title: EntitySummary
EntitySummary.description:
The generic summary returned by the entities that had no board of their own.

(endorsements, collections, claims, documents, inspections, offerings)

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description:
Polymorphic target of ``document`` / ``activity`` / ``note`` / ``agent_thread``.

Mirrors the S3 route ``documents/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/...``.

EvidenceLevel.title: EvidenceLevel
EvidenceLevel.description: How sure we are a payment happened. ORDERED weakest -> strongest.

ExpedienteActivity.title: ExpedienteActivity
ExpedienteActivity.description: One bitácora row — stage events, activity rows and notes, newest first.

ExpedienteAntecedentes.title: ExpedienteAntecedentes
ExpedienteAntecedentes.description:
The intake index — recommended slots + free uploads + extractions.

Scoped exactly like ``ai._antecedentes_documents``: cotización / comparison
categories never leak in (they belong to Comparación).

ExpedienteAntecedentesSlot.title: ExpedienteAntecedentesSlot
ExpedienteAntecedentesSlot.description: One recommended-file slot of the ramo, filled or missing.

ExpedienteCaseFile.title: ExpedienteCaseFile
ExpedienteCaseFile.description: The folder itself: what it is, when it runs, whether it is frozen.

ExpedienteClient.title: ExpedienteClient
ExpedienteClient.description: One RUT of the account: ``account_client`` rows ∪ the placements' clients.

ExpedienteComparisonColumn.title: ExpedienteComparisonColumn
ExpedienteComparisonColumn.description: One insurer column of the aligned matrix.

ExpedienteDocument.title: ExpedienteDocument
ExpedienteDocument.description:
A document of the folder. **No S3 key ever** (rule 8) — the bytes are
fetched through ``GET /documents/{id}/content`` like everywhere else.

ExpedienteGroup.title: ExpedienteGroup
ExpedienteGroup.description: The grupo-cuenta the folder hangs off. Carries no money and no stage.

ExpedienteJourneyStep.title: ExpedienteJourneyStep
ExpedienteJourneyStep.description:
One milestone of Antecedentes → Bases Técnicas → Comparación → Propuesta
→ Pólizas.

``completed_at`` comes from a real ``case_file_stage_event`` and is ``null``
when the machine never recorded the move (an imported or force-moved folder),
even if the milestone reads ``complete``. It is never inferred.

ExpedienteMoney.title: ExpedienteMoney
ExpedienteMoney.description:
The account's money core, reconciled through ``reconcile_money``.

``net = taxable + exempt`` · ``vat = 0.19 × taxable`` (never on net) ·
``total = net + vat``. ``derived_fields`` names what code computed because
the source left it blank; ``warnings`` carries the soft (rate) checks.

ExpedienteProposal.title: ExpedienteProposal
ExpedienteProposal.description: The outbound ``broker_proposal`` (never an insurer's inbound offer).

ExpedienteRecommendation.title: ExpedienteRecommendation
ExpedienteRecommendation.description: The named AI pick of the comparison (v9 requires a pick + rationale).

ExportColumnInfo.title: ExportColumnInfo
ExportColumnInfo.description: One exportable column, for the frontend's column picker.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Subconjunto ordenado de columnas; None = todas las de la entidad.

group_by.title: Group By
group_by.description: Si se indica, el archivo exporta los buckets agregados en vez de las filas.

ExtractionRead.title: ExtractionRead
ExtractionRead.description: The persisted AI job — the audit trail, always returned with the suggestion.

ExtractionRequest.title: ExtractionRequest
ExtractionRequest.description: Ask the model to read one already-uploaded document.

ExtractionSuggestionResponse.title: ExtractionSuggestionResponse
ExtractionSuggestionResponse.description: SUGGEST step: what the model read, plus everything needed to review it.

GroupClientRef.title: GroupClientRef
GroupClientRef.description: The derived primary RUT: the contratante of the latest ``period_start``.

GroupTimelineEntry.title: GroupTimelineEntry
GroupTimelineEntry.description:
One merged row of the group timeline (stage events, activity, notes,
policies, endorsements, claims, collections), newest FIRST.

GroupTimelinePage.title: GroupTimelinePage
GroupTimelinePage.description:
``GET /account-groups/{id}/timeline?limit=50&before=<iso>``.

``next_before`` is the ``occurred_at`` of the last entry returned, or
``None`` when the page was not full — pass it back as ``before`` to
continue; there is no offset pagination on a merged timeline.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Las dimensiones que esta entidad sabe responder.

money_field.title: Money Field
money_field.description: Qué columna suma ``total_uf`` (None = la entidad no lleva plata).

GroupedSummary.title: GroupedSummary
GroupedSummary.description: The chart-ready payload returned by ``?group_by=`` on a summary.

InspectionAssign.title: InspectionAssign
InspectionAssign.description: Assign (or clear) the inspector who owns the report.

InspectionChecklistUpdate.title: InspectionChecklistUpdate
InspectionChecklistUpdate.description: Replace the checklist wholesale; the version tracks its template.

InspectionVersionCreate.title: InspectionVersionCreate
InspectionVersionCreate.description: Fork an existing inspection into the next version for the same asset.

InstallmentReplace.title: InstallmentReplace
InstallmentReplace.description: Full replace of the ledger — the Σ is validated before anything is written.

InstallmentResult.title: InstallmentResult
InstallmentResult.description: A cuota write (debit rejected, promise): the cuota's new state.

InstallmentRow.title: InstallmentRow
InstallmentRow.description: One cuota on the Cobranza board (live state, not the cache).

InsuredSummary.title: InsuredSummary
InsuredSummary.description: The canonical insured, as embedded in every client payload.

InsurerCapability.title: InsurerCapability
InsurerCapability.description: What a broker sees of an insurer's cobranza. No onboarding status, ever.

InsurerContactCreate.title: InsurerContactCreate
InsurerContactCreate.description:
Create a contact.

``scope='broker'`` (default) binds the contact to the caller's broker;
``scope='global'`` creates a platform-wide default and is platform-only.
``insurance_line_id`` NULL means the contact serves all lines.

InsurerContactUpdate.title: InsurerContactUpdate
InsurerContactUpdate.description: Partial update of a contact. Scope (broker) cannot be changed.

InsurerCreate.title: InsurerCreate
InsurerCreate.description: Create a canonical insurer. ``rut`` + ``cmf_code`` are the identity.

InsurerMatchRequest.title: InsurerMatchRequest
InsurerMatchRequest.description:
Input for ``find_or_create_insurer`` — matching uses rut/cmf_code ONLY.

``legal_name`` is carried for display when a NEW row has to be created; it is
never used to match an existing insurer (OCR yields "HDI Seguros S.A." /
"HDI SEGUROS SA" / "H.D.I.").

InsurerRead.title: InsurerRead
InsurerRead.description:
An insurer as seen by the requesting broker.

``native_profile`` is populated only for native insurers; ``can_edit`` tells
the UI whether to render the edit control enabled (no dead buttons).

InsurerRecommendation.title: InsurerRecommendation
InsurerRecommendation.description: A native insurer suggested for a given insurance line.

InsurerRef-Input.title: InsurerRef
InsurerRef-Input.description:
How the extraction names the issuing insurer.

Matching is by NORMALISED ``cmf_code`` / ``rut`` ONLY — never by name
(docs §4.3). ``legal_name`` is carried for display and for creating the row
when no match exists, not for lookup.

InsurerUpdate.title: InsurerUpdate
InsurerUpdate.description: Partial update. Identity fields are platform-only (enforced in the router).

LeadAssetInput.title: LeadAssetInput
LeadAssetInput.description: The minimum an asset needs so the placement has something to sit on.

LeadConversionResult.title: LeadConversionResult
LeadConversionResult.description: Everything the conversion created, in one payload.

LeadConvert.title: LeadConvert
LeadConvert.description: Advance a lead into a real case: insured + client + placement + case file.

LineAssignmentRequest.title: LineAssignmentRequest
LineAssignmentRequest.description: Assign a broker line (or an adopted template) to an account.

LineUsage.title: LineUsage
LineUsage.description: How many of the broker's accounts (and distinct groups) resolve to a line.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description: Login returns the token pair plus the profile, so the SPA boots in one call.

MailAccountRead.title: MailAccountRead
MailAccountRead.description: A mailbox. ``id`` is ``None`` for the virtual Radal system sender entry.

MailMessageStatus.title: MailMessageStatus
MailMessageStatus.description: ``skipped`` = recorded but not sent because ``MAIL_ENABLED`` is off.

MailProviderOption.title: MailProviderOption
MailProviderOption.description: A connectable provider for the "Conectar casilla" picker (no dead buttons).

MailSender.title: MailSender
MailSender.description: Who sends broker mail: the Radal system mailbox or a connected account.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description: ``GET /auth/me`` — the authenticated profile and its organization.

MessageExchange.title: MessageExchange
MessageExchange.description: One turn: what the user said and what the assistant answered.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Diff paths to queue. Empty = every row of the current diff.

MirrorDiffRowRead.title: MirrorDiffRowRead
MirrorDiffRowRead.description: One field where the issued policy departs from the issuance proposal.

NativeInsurerProfileUpdate.title: NativeInsurerProfileUpdate
NativeInsurerProfileUpdate.description: Partial update of the commercial profile — every field optional.

NativeInsurerProfileWrite.title: NativeInsurerProfileWrite
NativeInsurerProfileWrite.description: Commercial terms for a Radal partner insurer. Platform-managed.

NotificationCount.title: NotificationCount
NotificationCount.description: Unseen (``new``) rows per tray — the bell badge.

NotificationRead.title: NotificationRead
NotificationRead.description: One bell entry. ``params`` is render data (the frontend formats it).

OfferingDecisionRequest.title: OfferingDecisionRequest
OfferingDecisionRequest.description:
The insured's public choice: which proposal, plus an optional note.

This is a PUBLIC WRITE path — the narrow projection IS the only guard, so
nothing here (or in ``OfferingPublicRead``) may carry a broker-internal id.

OfferingPublicProposal.title: OfferingPublicProposal
OfferingPublicProposal.description:
Headline figures of a proposal, for the public page.

``id`` is the ``proposal.id`` — the insured posts it back to record a choice.
Commission and every broker-internal field are deliberately absent.

OfferingPublicRead.title: OfferingPublicRead
OfferingPublicRead.description: The unauthenticated share-link view. No broker/internal ids, no commission.

OfferingSend.title: OfferingSend
OfferingSend.description: Record how the offering left the building. Sending itself is manual.

OnboardingStatus.title: OnboardingStatus
OnboardingStatus.description: Radal-internal Forpay onboarding of an insurer. NEVER shown to brokers.

OperabilityRead.title: OperabilityRead
OperabilityRead.description: One feature of the policy and whether its data is complete (R38).

OrganizationSummary.title: OrganizationSummary
OrganizationSummary.description:
The user's home organization, whichever family they belong to.

``type`` mirrors ``user.user_type`` (broker | insurer | insured). Platform
users have no home organization and get ``null``.

OriginChainEntry.title: OriginChainEntry
OriginChainEntry.description: One folder of the origin chain, oldest first: new -> renewal -> …

PackKind.title: PackKind
PackKind.description: The three generated downloadables of an expediente.

PackSummaryConfirm.title: PackSummaryConfirm
PackSummaryConfirm.description: Suggest → human edit → confirm, applied to prose (§7.5).

PartiesReplace.title: PartiesReplace
PartiesReplace.description:
Replace the policy's parties wholesale: exactly one ``policyholder``,
at least one ``insured``, at most one ``payer``.

PartyContact.title: PartyContact
PartyContact.description: A contratante / pagador typed in the manual form: name + RUT + contact.

PartyRole.title: PartyRole
PartyRole.description:
Role of a person/company on a policy. Payer defaults to policyholder,
policyholder defaults to insured (service rule).

PaymentCurrency.title: PaymentCurrency
PaymentCurrency.description: Currency a payment was actually made in (CLP is converted to UF).

PaymentResult.title: PaymentResult
PaymentResult.description: A payment write: the payment and the cuota's new state.

PaymentStatus.title: PaymentStatus
PaymentStatus.description: A payment is never deleted; it is reversed.

PendingAction.title: PendingAction
PendingAction.description:
One actionable gap in the account, for the overview Journey.

``code`` is an English token, ``severity`` is ``info | warning | blocker``,
``tab`` names the desk that owns the fix, ``reason`` is the human sentence,
and ``count`` is how many items the gap covers (1 for a singleton).

PermissionsResponse.title: PermissionsResponse
PermissionsResponse.description:
``GET /auth/permissions`` — the effective RBAC matrix, for UI gating.

``matrix`` keeps the raw grants ("yes" | "no" | "partial") so the UI can
render a partial state; ``allowed`` is the coarse boolean the UI uses to
show / disable a control. Tenant scoping is NOT expressed here — it is
always applied on top, server-side.

PlacementCreate.title: PlacementCreate
PlacementCreate.description:
Open a placement on one of the broker's assets.

``client_id`` is derived from the asset — it is never taken from the body,
so a placement can never be filed against another client's asset.

PlacementListItem.title: PlacementListItem
PlacementListItem.description: One row of the placements list.

PlacementRef.title: PlacementRef
PlacementRef.description: Just enough placement context for a quote list row.

PlacementRefSummary.title: PlacementRefSummary
PlacementRefSummary.description: A minimal reference (client / asset / insurance line) embedded in a row.

grouped.description: Buckets listos para el gráfico cuando se pide ?group_by=.

PlacementSummary.title: PlacementSummary
PlacementSummary.description: Aggregate counters for the placements list view.

PlacementTransition.title: PlacementTransition
PlacementTransition.description: Move a placement to the next status, with an optional audit note.

PlacementTransitionOptions.title: PlacementTransitionOptions
PlacementTransitionOptions.description: What the UI may offer right now (so no control is ever a dead button).

PlacementUpdate.title: PlacementUpdate
PlacementUpdate.description: Patch a placement. ``status`` is intentionally absent — use /transition.

PolicyCurrency.title: PolicyCurrency
PolicyCurrency.description: Currency a policy (and its cuotas) is denominated in. ISO-style codes.

PolicyDetail.title: PolicyDetail
PolicyDetail.description: ``GET /policies/{id}`` — the ficha: row + parties, "Falta: X", journey.

PolicyFromProposal.title: PolicyFromProposal
PolicyFromProposal.description: Build the draft policy from the accepted proposal — the mirror baseline.

PolicyJourneyRead.title: PolicyJourneyRead
PolicyJourneyRead.description: Where the policy sits in its colocación: entered vs skipped stages.

grouped.description: Buckets listos para el gráfico cuando se pide ?group_by=.

PolicySummary.title: PolicySummary
PolicySummary.description:
The portfolio board: status split, live premium, and the renewal clock.

``total_premium_uf`` sums only ACTIVE policies — that is the premium the
broker is actually administering — and ``expiring_within_60_days`` counts
active policies whose ``end_date`` falls inside the next 60 days.

PolicyUploadRequest.title: PolicyUploadRequest
PolicyUploadRequest.description:
``POST /policies/upload`` — validate-then-dynamic policy ingestion.

Point at an already-filed ``document``; the server runs the context-aware
POLICY extraction, checks the fixed minimal core and (unless ``override``)
refuses a file that does not look like a policy with a 422 ``not_a_policy``.

PolicyUploadResponse.title: PolicyUploadResponse
PolicyUploadResponse.description: The committed policy plus the core verdict and provenance.

ProposalConfirm.title: ProposalConfirm
ProposalConfirm.description: Human confirmation of an AI-prefilled proposal (suggest -> confirm -> commit).

ProposalConfirmRequest.title: ProposalConfirmRequest
ProposalConfirmRequest.description: COMMIT step: the reviewed (possibly edited) suggestion becomes a proposal.

ProposalCreate.title: ProposalCreate
ProposalCreate.description:
Create a proposal.

``source_document_id`` is MANDATORY (rule 3): a proposal cannot exist without
the file it was read from. The insurer must already carry ``rut`` +
``cmf_code``; both are checked by the router.

ProposalDecisionResult.title: ProposalDecisionResult
ProposalDecisionResult.description: Outcome of accept/reject — the whole cascade, in one payload.

ProposalInsurerCount.title: ProposalInsurerCount
ProposalInsurerCount.description: One insurer's slice of the proposal flow (the by-insurer leaderboard).

ProposalOrigin.title: ProposalOrigin
ProposalOrigin.description: Where the proposal came from: a Radal-native insurer or an external one.

ProposalSuggestion-Input.title: ProposalSuggestion
ProposalSuggestion-Input.description: The standard proposal shape — AI-filled, human-editable, not yet committed.

ProposalSuggestion-Output.title: ProposalSuggestion
ProposalSuggestion-Output.description: The standard proposal shape — AI-filled, human-editable, not yet committed.

grouped.description: Buckets listos para el gráfico cuando se pide ?group_by=.

ProposalSummary.title: ProposalSummary
ProposalSummary.description:
The proposals board: status split, insurer mix, and the money in play.

``total_premium_uf`` and ``avg_rate_permille`` aggregate only proposals
still in the running (draft / submitted / accepted) — a declined, withdrawn
or expired offer is not money on the table.

ProposalUpdate.title: ProposalUpdate
ProposalUpdate.description:
Partial update. ``quote_request_id`` is immutable — recreate instead.

Sending ``coverages`` REPLACES the whole set; omitting it leaves the existing
coverage/exclusion rows untouched.

PublicInstructions.title: PublicInstructions
PublicInstructions.description: How to pay the insurer directly (Radal profile ⊕ broker override).

PublicShareRead.title: PublicShareRead
PublicShareRead.description: The audience projection. Unknown/revoked/expired tokens never get here (404).

PublicWriteResult.title: PublicWriteResult
PublicWriteResult.description: What a public write answers: an acknowledgement, never internal ids.

QuoteLineItemUpdate.title: QuoteLineItemUpdate
QuoteLineItemUpdate.description: Partial update — only the fields actually sent are applied.

QuoteRequestCreate.title: QuoteRequestCreate
QuoteRequestCreate.description: Create a quote request against one of the broker's own placements.

QuoteRequestSend.title: QuoteRequestSend
QuoteRequestSend.description: Mark a draft quote request as sent to a set of insurers.

grouped.description: Buckets listos para el gráfico cuando se pide ?group_by=.

QuoteRequestSummary.title: QuoteRequestSummary
QuoteRequestSummary.description: The quotes board: totals, the status split and the two clocks.

QuoteRequestUpdate.title: QuoteRequestUpdate
QuoteRequestUpdate.description:
Partial update. ``placement_id`` is immutable — recreate instead.

Sending ``line_items`` REPLACES the whole set (the child rows are owned by
the quote request); omitting it leaves the existing items untouched.

QuotingInsurer.title: QuotingInsurer
QuotingInsurer.description:
One insurer that actually quoted, as the list column renders it.

``name`` is the same display name the rest of the API uses for an insurer
(``trade_name`` when it exists, else ``legal_name``) so the Cotizaciones
column reads identically to the comparacion and the expediente.

RamoField-Input.title: RamoField
RamoField-Input.description: One field of a section. ``list``/``group`` carry nested ``fields``.

RamoField-Output.title: RamoField
RamoField-Output.description: One field of a section. ``list``/``group`` carry nested ``fields``.

RamoSchema-Input.title: RamoSchema
RamoSchema-Input.description: The whole sectioned definition — the API view of ``definition``.

RamoSchema-Output.title: RamoSchema
RamoSchema-Output.description: The whole sectioned definition — the API view of ``definition``.

RecipientRead.title: RecipientRead
RecipientRead.description:
A native insurer + the contact the broker+line → broker → line → global
precedence resolves to.

RecommendedFile.title: RecommendedFile
RecommendedFile.description:
One recommended antecedentes document for a ramo (the corrected v9 shape).

This is the FIRST-CLASS content of a ramo — the recommended files a broker
should gather, each with human ``label`` + ``description`` (context) +
``required`` and an expected ``format``. Advisory: it drives the uploader's
"recommended files" checklist; it never gates the consolidation or the PDF.

``category`` / ``doc_type`` both name the document type — ``category`` maps to
a :class:`DocumentCategory` value where one fits; ``doc_type`` is the free
label when it does not. ``format`` is the expected upload format ("pdf",
"word", "pdf/word", "image").

RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest
RefreshRequest.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh token pair (rotation).

RequiredField.title: RequiredField
RequiredField.description:
One mandatory field of the resolved line, addressed by section + key.

Used for BOTH the uploader checklist (``required_fields`` — the whole
mandatory list) and the gap list (``missing_required`` — the subset still
empty in the payload). ``label`` is the human display label (Spanish ok).

ResolvedContact.title: ResolvedContact
ResolvedContact.description: The effective contact for (insurer, broker, line) + which tier answered.

date_from.title: Date From
date_from.description: Desde (inclusive) sobre la fecha natural de la entidad.

date_to.title: Date To
date_to.description: Hasta (inclusive) sobre la fecha natural de la entidad.

status.title: Status
status.description: Estado de la entidad, si aplica.

ScopeFilterPayload.title: ScopeFilterPayload
ScopeFilterPayload.description:
The uniform filter vocabulary, as a request body (used by the exports).

Mirrors the query params every list / summary endpoint accepts. ``status``
and the entity-specific extras are passed through ``extra`` so one body can
serve thirteen entities without thirteen schemas.

ShareLinkRead.title: ShareLinkRead
ShareLinkRead.description: One link as the broker sees it (token + ready-to-send URLs included).

SharePermissions.title: SharePermissions
SharePermissions.description: The four link capabilities. Omitted keys take the audience defaults.

StageStateRead.title: StageStateRead
StageStateRead.description: One tick of the journey rail: entered stages solid, skipped ones grey.

SuggestedEntry.title: SuggestedEntry
SuggestedEntry.description: How a subtipo is usually entered (team CSV ``entrada_sugerida``).

label.title: Label
label.description: Etiqueta legible derivada del dato, no traducida.

total_uf.title: Total Uf
total_uf.description: Suma de la columna de dinero de la entidad, si tiene.

SummaryBucket.title: SummaryBucket
SummaryBucket.description: One bar / slice of a grouped summary.

SummaryRead.title: SummaryRead
SummaryRead.description: AI prose, always UNCONFIRMED: suggest -> edit -> confirmar.

ThreadCreate.title: ThreadCreate
ThreadCreate.description: Open a conversation. ``proposal``/``quote`` scope anchors it to an entity.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: One merged row of stage events + activity + notes, newest last.

TokenPair.title: TokenPair
TokenPair.description: Access + refresh tokens. ``expires_in`` is the access token TTL (seconds).

TreePeriodNode.title: TreePeriodNode
TreePeriodNode.description:
One vigencia: a label grouping accounts; ``start``/``end`` are the
extremes of its accounts' full dates (they may differ per ramo).

TreePostSaleNode.title: TreePostSaleNode
TreePostSaleNode.description: One post-sale child case (endorsement / collection / claim) of a policy.

TreeRenewal.title: TreeRenewal
TreeRenewal.description:
The RENOVACIÓN leaf: a link when a renewal folder exists, otherwise
whether ``POST /case-files/{id}/renew`` would be accepted and why not.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
Invite / create a user inside the caller's organization.

``password`` is optional: when omitted the API generates a temporary one and
returns it ONCE in ``UserInviteResponse.temporary_password`` (there is no
outbound email delivery in this pass — see the router docstring).

``broker_id`` / ``insurer_id`` / ``insured_id`` are honoured ONLY for a
platform user creating a user in another organization; for every other actor
the home organization is forced from the authenticated user.

UserInviteResponse.title: UserInviteResponse
UserInviteResponse.description:
Result of creating a user.

``temporary_password`` is populated only when the API generated one; it is
shown exactly once and never stored in clear text.

UserRoleUpdate.title: UserRoleUpdate
UserRoleUpdate.description: Change a user's RBAC role (within their own actor family).

UserSummary.title: UserSummary
UserSummary.description: The slice of a user any list/detail view needs (e.g. account manager).

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: Editable profile fields. Role and status have their own endpoints.

WarrantySource.title: WarrantySource
WarrantySource.description: Where an R-n / G-n / M-n obligation came from.

app__schemas__ai__InsurerRef.title: InsurerRef
app__schemas__ai__InsurerRef.description:
How the extraction names the issuing insurer.

Matching is by NORMALISED ``cmf_code`` / ``rut`` ONLY — never by name
(docs §4.3). ``legal_name`` is carried for display and for creating the row
when no match exists, not for lookup.

app__schemas__catalog__SubtypeRef.title: SubtypeRef
app__schemas__catalog__SubtypeRef.description: The compact ``{id, code, name}`` reference rows and lists embed.

app__schemas__proposal__InsurerRef.title: InsurerRef
app__schemas__proposal__InsurerRef.description: Insurer identity as the comparator needs it: rut + cmf_code, never a name match.
